rules.rule: The work definition includes manpower supplied to work under the recipient's supervision, control or direction.

Recipient-directed manpower may support a provisional contract-work candidate; eligibility and legal treatment require review. Prototype proposal limited to declared Indian resident private company payers.
Reference only. Vendor control does not by itself establish professional or technical services. No rate or threshold implemented.
